blocks.title: The Dragonets of the Circular Island

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Well… Alright, friends. Let us begin. We start this campaign, and we start this adventure together in a place that the four of you know well: the Circular Island, which is, for purposes of today and for the next sessions, part of an endless sea stretching out as far as the eye and the mind can see.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And this island, perfectly circular, dotted with eight immense statues. And these statues, each representing a different divine entity from times long lost. And for you all, and for dragonets, these names are lost and meaningless, but once upon a time they were called the Mother, the Father, the Night Queen, the Warlord, the Sibyl, the Wanderer, the Wyrdling, and the Wildling. But for you all, as dragonets and as part of a very, very special and beautiful community, each of these eight statues represents home, represents culture, represents community.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And as we begin, each of these eight statues, which in dragonet parlance have actually different names: the Mother is known as the Moon Lady. The Father is known as Brightface. The Night Queen is known as the Dark Lady. The Warlord is Old Iron. The Sibyl is the Pretty One. The Wanderer is still the Wanderer. The Wyrdling is Crooked Luck. And the Wildling is the Tangle.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Each of these immense statues is home for a different dragonet community. And each of these communities, over time, have developed and evolved their own weird little cultures with their own idiosyncrasies and their own passions and knacks and weird little things that happen in their own spaces. And each of these statues is literal, physical home for many dragonets. Depending on the statue, some dragonets are nestled within the cracked and broken robes of the Dark Lady. Some are nestled within the foot structures of Old Iron. Each dragonet community finding its own way to work with the large statue and the stone to then find their own nests where clutches of dragonet eggs can be hatched and cared for and loved. And where, also crucially, incredible fun can be had, games can be played, and bright and generous and kind lives can be lived.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And so, today, we begin this moment first, not attached to what soon will be a very important event in the dragonet calendar, which is the dragonet festival called the Jubilee, which takes over the entire island and happens once per year, and is the major, major gathering and moment and celebration for the entire dragonet community, where all of the great communities of the dragonets, the eight communities, gather and celebrate the great games, the sing-offs, the call-and-responses, the great finds, all of the incredible games that everybody's been looking forward to playing all year.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: But before we bring into that, I'd like to bring us into the four characters, the four dragonets that are gonna be the heroes and the main characters of our story here: Heska, and Little Tony, and Sculpit, and Zeno.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And I'd like to first bring us into one of the very, very special places, certainly for Little Tony and Sculpit. And for Little Tony and Sculpit, one of the most important places to the both of them is a very, very special part of the Wanderer statue. And up high, high above the clouds, the Wanderer's hand and palm is reached out, out into the horizon. A symbol for adventure, for journeying, for welcoming the unknown. And… Silly. Listen.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: So cool!

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And so, I'd like to begin with, Sculpit and Little Tony. For…

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Put him in the hand.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: What's that?

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: You could put them in the hand.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Dude, this is the powers that are possible. There they are. So, I'd like to begin first with Sculpit and Little Tony, whichever one of you would like to go first, but to share about your character, and anything you'd like to share about your character, actually. This can be sort of a god view, omnipotent view of your character, and anything about them that, just from a third-person narrative perspective, we can all learn. But then also tell us about this palm. And why is this space so important to you individually, but then also for the two of you together in your friendship?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Do you want to go first? Should I jump in? So, Little Tony moves through the island surrounded everywhere he goes by stuff that talks to him. Not in, like, an ethereal, mystical, beautiful way, but in the way that, like, that rock has problems, and it wants to tell Little Tony about its problems that it has, and this stick over here is actually part of the elaborate community of all of the sticks that have washed up on shore and has a long-running feud with the driftwood that comes from outside of the island. And all of them, because there aren't any other dragonets that speak with things like this, all of them just want to unburden themselves all the time to Little Tony.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: It's really frustrating. Like, he's a druid, and his former familiar, who is now his ex-familiar, Glenda the Seagull, like, fell in love with him, and he had to convince her—

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Here.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: —that he was not going to be in a relationship with a seagull. And now, and this is what he's up in the hand talking about today, is he's updating… Because he also doesn't want to let her down. He feels positively towards this ex, so there's an increasingly elaborate deception about the girlfriend that he's currently in a relationship with, so as to let the seagull down gently, who isn't his familiar anymore but comes from time to time. And he's sort of roped Heska into this, even though Heska doesn't actually talk to the seagull.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Like…

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: When Tony's talking to the seagull, he needs to look over to Heska from…

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Wait, fruit. Paul said. Say?

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: My character's Sculpit.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Oh, sorry, Sculpit. He needs to, like… Sculpit needs to collaborate and nod at the right times and things, so Tony's running him through the paces. And, you know, Little Tony is still very much into the celebration and the dragonet culture and world and everything. He doesn't compete in the performances so much as, through his network of contacts, like his buddy Horseshoe Crab, who runs the tide pools, he finds interesting and unusual things to sort of bring and display and show off. Or, in this case, helping out Sculpit, who he admires as a very talented coach and choreographer and runner of performers.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: And he's up in the hand because this is one of the very, very few places—I think this is the only place he's found on the island—where nothing talks to him. Like, even though there's trees and plants and moss and rocks and things, they're all just quiet, and sometimes he needs to just get away from all of the issues. So it's good to be up here.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Schwartz, just as a side note, the one other place that you also find that the voices in your head stop is if you fly out over the ocean and you get close to the storm that surrounds the island. But who goes and flies out there on the regular? But you've noticed… Yeah.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: There's also the problem, like, there is this cloud that, whenever it sees me get too far, just has an infra—like, it thinks I am wasting my life, and just won't stop sometimes. She's like, ‘Don't go farther than me!’

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: But on the very few times that you've ever ventured out there, you've noticed also that it gets quiet when you get closer to the storm. Shout out to Little Tony. Sculpit.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: So Sculpit's up in the hand listening, which is… Welcoming Little Tony into this place is not something that happens in one day. Sculpit is—

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Bye-bye.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: —a behind-the-scenes guy, the creative director and coach and… Eater and tougher. He likes making other people better, but doesn't like the spotlight himself. He's very much the guy who is on the edge, giving somebody some good advice on how to make the performance better, not performing himself. And he loves the sort of performance culture of the islands, but he often feels disconnected from the hustle and bustle of the daily dragonet life. Other than when everybody's cheering for an amazing singer or something like that, he kind of feels that… He feels part of that community, but a lot of the time he feels like everybody's always showing off and being buoyant, and he's kind of quiet and in the background much more.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: And so he comes up to this hand, this place up here, to think and plan out his next sort of choreographic routine for his current… ‘People’ is not the right word, but the person he's currently coaching through their scenes. And for the longest time, he thought he was the only one who knew of this place. And discovering another person up here kind of changed his whole attitude on, well, maybe there are some other dragonets who it's like, we could form a little community that's not a big group. And he's very much now sort of attached to this little place with another person to listen to. He's nodding along. In his head, he's thinking, ‘Where's my sparkly things? Where's my sparkly things?’ But he's nodding along and is supportive of Little Tony's life problems. He sometimes thinks that if Little Tony would just take some advice from somebody that isn't a rock, or a cloud, or a twig, or a stick, life would be better. But, you know, to each their own, right?

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: So he's a bard, right? He knows a lot, right? He has this deep store of… He's always coming up with odd facts about history, or nature, or things like that. Never quite sure where he gets them from. Nobody's quite sure if he's made them up or has some source of knowledge, but he'll spout off, ‘Oh, well, sure, this statue used to be called such-and-such. It was built by so-and-so,’ and whatever. Maybe it's right, maybe it's wrong. These housekeeping listen. Down. So that's Sculpit. And today he's kind of in a panic. I don't know how much this is something you're gonna get.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Right? You can say a little bit, yeah, go for it.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: But he's in a panic right now, because his star client has completely forgotten to prepare. Permission. And he has come to Little Tony to put out the call amongst his beasts and creatures and twigs and rocks and crabs and seagulls and whoever else. Let's see what can be found to make this costume a success. So he doesn't quite have the patience that he would normally.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Has the key.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: Just kind of thinking, ‘Can we get to my problem?’ He doesn't say it. He's too attuned to say it. He's keeping to listening. He's listening for that moment when you're ready to switch gears away from your problem to his problem.

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: I think it's, like, a regular thing, like, the update on Glenda the Seagull every week is just, like… You gotta get it out. Like, no one else will listen to this.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: So the palm is the source of therapy and ability for Little Tony to finally release. Beautiful, y'all. Well, we'll come back to the palm in a moment, but now we're gonna shift scenes and go to the neighborhood and the community of the Dark Lady.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And so, the Dark Lady. Again, each dragonet community: different, diverse, connected to their own statues. Much of the neighborhood's built in the cracks of the robes, and is the home of Heska and Zeno, who also are friends and have known each other for quite some time. And Zeno and Heska, please introduce yourselves and your relationship.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: So Zeno, for like the thirteenth time today, is like, ‘Yo. Now I'm back to thinking… The Chuckle Buckle. People would like that, I think, right? Because she has a giant shoe, you know, that thing that holds on the shoe, that… I think, in ancient times, that was called a buckle. And if people want to come out for a show, they're not gonna remember, you know, Dark Lady Night. They know about the Dark Lady. And so, it's gotta pop. It's gotta have some magic to it if we want people to come to the comedy show. You know what I'm saying?’

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Zeno is trying to get something together. He would love to form a crew around him and get a scene going based on his spoken-word prowess. But he's working on it. He is an orange dragonet with green highlights. He's got a scarf that he's very proud of that's dotted with tiny gems. You often see him just toss it over his shoulder, even though he just did that a few seconds ago, to draw attention to it. And nobody can defeat him in a battle of wits or words. Or so he thinks.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And what about your relationship to Heska?

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Well, Heska is gonna be the nightclub manager in Zeno's mind. I don't know if Heska sees it that way. Heska might have just stumbled into this by accident. But we do collect delicious eggs together sometimes.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Heska is patiently listening to Zeno change his mind for probably the twelfth time today about what he wants to call this club that he's been talking about for probably the past six months and has not, in fact, done anything to establish. But Heska is patient, and every now and then he'll try and redirect Zeno a little bit to some memory back from one of the earlier Jubilees or something, where Zeno had some big moment or something like that.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: And what Zeno doesn't notice, but what our omniscient third-party observer sees, is that when he manages to get Zeno talking at length about some fancy memory of Zeno's past great triumphs—and most of Zeno's past events are great triumphs—something will just, you know, a little handkerchief or something will just lift quietly out of Zeno's pocket and drift across the air. And Zeno never notices, but eventually will go to grab his handkerchief, and there's not a handkerchief there anymore. There's a deflating wet balloon, or some such other loud, silly rubber chick—well, it's probably not rubber chickens, but a noisy, loud… Maybe an egg.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Funny eggshell.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: A slimy eggshell in his pocket instead. But you can tell, you're the omniscient third-party observer, that he does this not out of malice, but out of a sense of love for Zeno's story and trying to keep him from inflating his ego more than a reasonable size.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And what is Heska known for on the island?

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Heska would prefer not to be known for much, but if you asked somebody, what they would probably describe is a couple times that he has flown out over the ocean and brought back something strange and weird for the Dark Lady communal feasts. The thing people talk about the most is a giant fiddler crab, twice the size of any dragonet, with a claw nearly the size of Heska's torso and head, that he brought back and cooked up in a very nice crab boil. But the shell is decorated in this swirling rainbow that looks like crashing waves, and he keeps promising Zeno, once you finally settle on a name, you can decorate your club with the giant fiddler crab shell.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And this fits in perfectly with some of the larger dragonet culture around finding and displaying cool shit. And this could be… and this is also why Little Tony is so sought after by so many across the island, because of his unusual capacity and ability to find all the cool, strange shit on the island, which maybe is a burden, maybe it's a source of pride? Little Tony, can you say a little more about your relationship to this… this energy on the island, related to your…

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: Last year, I came in third place in one of the Finding Interesting Thing competitions because I found a pebble that looked like a butt, and it looked so much like a butt. It was… Pebble butt. And even the people who thought it was ridiculous and, like, ‘This is not an appropriate thing,’ were like, ‘Yeah, but it looks like a butt.’

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: And so, yeah, he spends a lot of the time, because he has this community of things that talks to him everywhere he goes, he just goes out and spends a lot of time wandering around and talking with inanimate objects and looking for interesting things to find and bring back. So sometimes his part in some of the competitions is finding that, when you want a particular thing, Little Tony knows a guy who knows a guy, who knows a twig, who knows where it is. And that's the go-to. And he likes that. He likes finding things for people, and he likes just being out wandering around.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And just, again, the finding weird shit. There's both the finding weird shit that is strange objects, but there's also hunting things, and being able to feed the community is another incredible source of pride and joy in the dragonet community. And Heska, I know you've also had some expertise in that particular lane. This is something that you're known for a bit, even though you're not known for much. But one of these things is something you're very known for.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Heska likes to feed the Dark Lady. He's always bringing stuff back, but usually not in a way that draws attention to himself. He's actually often happy to let Zeno… It's a way to, you know, Zeno's doing a show, so Heska will cook up something nice and get everybody to come eat and watch the show.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: But Zeno's contribution is he's always by Heska's side, hyping him up while he's hunting.

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Yes. Yeah, Zeno comes to fly out and then just flies around, like, ‘You can kill that thing, you can find it.’ Doesn't actually do anything at all. Heska catches the thing and brings it back. But Heska likes it.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And what's an example of a thing or two that's, like, an exotic, strange thing or two that you've brought back that perhaps…

lines.speaker: Heska
lines.text: Well, the most famous is the fiddler crab, as previously described. His favorite thing to do is to steal eggs from the birds that nest on the cliffs and replace them with egg-sized rocks, which oftentimes the birds are too stupid to realize are not actually their eggs, and will sit on and incubate until they get confused. But he only does that occasionally, because he knows if he just takes the eggs, the birds will usually lay another one, and then that's more food for everybody. But he finds it funny.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Oh, that's… that's interesting.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: So, all of the four of you, again, you all know, you're all aware of each other. But certainly Sculpit and Little Tony definitely have a very unique and close friendship, much like Heska and Zeno do.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And that brings us now into the great festival, the Jubilee, sometimes formally called… What is it formally called? Well, Jubilee is what it's most commonly known as, but the Eightfold Festival, some of the elders will also refer to it that way. And we bring ourselves into the morning of the festival.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And the festival itself kicks off—it's a multi-day affair—and it kicks off just before sunset with a very important opening ceremony that occurs at sunset. Upon completion of the opening ceremony, where the elders will convene and conduct what is overall one of the few moments in dragonet culture that actually has some solemnity involved, it transitions immediately into… It's kind of like the Olympics starting ceremony. There's a huge set of performances, and those performances then transition into the games. And most importantly for today, and most importantly for Sculpit, Sculpit's advisee Xena has a critical and major role to play as a part of this opening ceremony.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: The solemnity of the opening with the elders is something that everyone—again, one of the very, very few times in dragonet culture that everybody takes this real seriously, because, and I'll share more, it relates to the clutches and the eggs and the families that are born and reborn throughout the festival time.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: But this particular day and this particular performance, Xena is gonna have a major moment, and Sculpit has been working with Xena behind the scenes for months and months for this big, big event. And so, as we bring ourselves into the morning of the festival… Let's see here.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: The festival itself takes place in the temple that's located at the center of the island. Pilgrimage roads lead from the center all the way out to each of the large eight statues: Brightface, the Wildling, or the Wanderer and beyond. But this morning, what happens is Xena, who is the star of the show.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: She is in a panic. And there's basically, in the main temple area, kind of like a green room area set over on a side, which is a large cabana area. And this is sort of the dry rehearsal period, where everybody that's gonna be doing some kind of performance—the various musicians have their instruments out, they're all doing their sound checks—everybody's just kind of trying to get ready in advance before everybody shows up. Obviously, this image has got everybody here, but imagine it, you know, like, this is before it all happens.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And so, we start this scene with Sculpit and Xena, but also with Little Tony, who Sculpit has brought by as a part of this preparation. And Xena is lovely. Xena is such a talent: an incredible flyer and acrobat, that's part of why she's so famous, but also an incredible vocalist, which is a very, very rare combination. Often in these dragonet parties and these dragonet sing-offs and these competitions that happen, usually it's around one skill. And Xena is a particular talent because she has this incredible body control and dexterity and physical performance, but also can sing.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And so, Sculpit, you are a little panicked because Xena is doing her usual thing, and she's a bit of a diva, but also completely forgetful, very, very late, and is freaking out. And she's freaking out for a couple of things. She's freaking out because she doesn't think that her costume is quite right. But she's also freaking out because she feels like she needs help from somebody that she has a bit of a crush on, and she's gonna tell you more about that in a moment.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: But Heska, you and Zeno are also here as a part of this opening ceremony prep part. A lot of the dragonets are just kind of, if you're curious, coming and hanging out. But frankly, a lot of the dragonets are out preparing their own shit, right? The great find is happening, so everybody's getting the coolest fucking random hunt that they've gotten, preparing it in the most beautiful way for the great hunt. For the great find, all the strange objects are being arrayed and set up in the tents. So this is just pre-party, major planning moment.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: And so, Heska and Zeno, you both are nearby, in a nearby tent, just hanging out, checking things out. But we start with Sculpit and with Little Tony, and Xena walks up to both of you. Xena, as a dragonet, has got just ripped arms, and her wings are super, super just svelte, and she's got this amazing energy about her, but has this huge pot belly. She just has this weird aerodynamic, like, you know, she's got this pot belly, which is tattooed and decorated with jewels, and is bedazzled. But she's also like:

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: ‘This is not enough. And Sculpit, you said you were gonna bring me some actual jewelry, and this shit does not look good, number one. And number two, for my acrobatics that's gonna happen later, you had this choreography for me, but I think it now should be a duet. And I need a duo.’

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: Rev.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: Going away, don't you think? We had this all organized! You sure?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: We had this all organized. I feel like you have not been organized at all. I have been ready, and I've been waiting for both… I know I came up with this idea of needing a partner just now, but I feel like it's something that you need to be delivering on as my chief advisor.

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: I have an idea for a partner.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Well, let's talk about two things. Let's talk about my outfit, and let's talk about my partner. What's going on with my outfit?

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: So remember when I told you that—and he sort of alludes to what he was gonna say for that— some things that I told you that we should repeat right back, but did you find anything, that would fit, like I asked? So, can you give us a minute? Little Tony sometimes, like… Can you just give it… we'll… we'll be right back.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Xena is staring daggers into both of you, just like, ‘What the fuck is going on? My belly is unadorned, my wings are bare, my scales are, like, a little flaky right now, like… What's the situation, you two? What's going on here?’

lines.speaker: Little Tony
lines.text: We'll huddle up, and then we'll get back.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Before you do that, I just want to share one other thing, and also, side note. So, everybody probably is aware of this, because Xena's kind of a big, you know, people know about Xena. Xena and Zeno are clutch mates, so they're actually siblings. They were born in the same clutch, and Zeno, part of why you're hanging around nearby this tent is because you know how Xena gets a little bit before these performances.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Yes, yes.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: So, and she gets a little edgy, and it's one of those things, you know, you as, you know, her sib and her bro, you've got, like, a little bit of a, you know, you're able to kind of smooth out these situations if necessary, so you're kind of just… you're kind of, like, keeping an eye out and just seeing what the temperature in the tent is, and it's starting to get a little hot. It's starting to get a little hot in the tent. So Xena's staring daggers at y'all, and is… and also, kinda… What's going on? What are you two doing?

lines.speaker: Sculpit
lines.text: Wow. I think a… I think a duet! It's a little complicated, but let's deal with the costume first.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Let's talk about the costume, you two figure this out. Zeno, come over here.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Zeno's little wings perk up. He spins around, says, ‘Oh, hello, little sister, you're all… all ready, aren't you? All ready for the show?’

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Because of these two fools, I'm not.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: All ready to go, no? Are they working a little too slow for ya. You got this. You don't need them. What's the matter?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Well, I think it's more that I demand a certain level of excellence that is not being delivered right now by my most trusted advisor, so…

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Well… Did you get it in writing? You could fire them.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Writing. Zeno… I need to confess something to you. And Xena kind of, like, gets over and leans over, like, closely and leans into you. Is that friend of yours here?

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Who's that?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: An acrobat, the one that can fly around. And hunt stuff.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Oh, you mean Heska? You mean Heska? Yeah, he's right over there. What's…

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Ever since he got that crab? A little crush on him.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Brilliant.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Dumped down.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: That crab is something. You know, we got big plans for that crab.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Yeah, but…

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Wait, let me tell you, I gotta… I'm trying to decide on the… oh, okay, go ahead.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: It was the crab.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: What do you think about the… the Chuckle Buckle? Or maybe it's the Buckle Chuckle?

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Yeah, I don't care about any of that. Okay, so look. Here's the thing. Here's the thing. I think what's gonna make this performance really take off is if Heska does it with me? Know what I mean? Like, we do it together.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Well… now, Heska's a very, very busy, dragonet, you know. Well, I have to approach this delicately.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: I'm just saying, if that doesn't happen, Xena's gonna have a meltdown.

lines.speaker: Zeno
lines.text: Let's just take a deep breath together. Yeah. And spit some fire, because let's get Heska. Come on.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Okay, okay, okay. Xena's really distracted right now. What are… Little Tony and Sculpit, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Little Tony
